subject: Request to convert unused trial days to milestone credits for POC acceleration
messages:
From: Oliver Wong <oliver@quoll.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@quoll.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quoll POC timeline — small ask

Hi Stephanie,

Quick one from our side — thanks again for the fast turnaround on the environment. We’ve run into a timing squeeze: two of our data science leads are out next week, which eats into the effective runway for the pilot.

We have about 12 unused days left on the POC window (based on scheduled work). Rather than ask for a straight time extension, would Redwood consider converting those unused days into a set of milestone credits we can redeem as we hit integration checkpoints?

High level ask: convert 12 unused days -> 2 milestone credits (each credit covers a 1-week engineering support burst / priority queue for inference tuning). We’d like credits to be usable within 60 days and applied against the pilot allocation (no extra billing at conversion).

If this is doable, we can lock in a short amendment and push the integration work forward this month. Otherwise we’ll request the standard 2-week extension.

Best,
Oliver
Oliver Wong
Head of ML Engineering, Quoll Analytics
oliver@quoll.ai

---
Attachments: none

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Wong <oliver@quoll.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quoll POC timeline — small ask

Hi Oliver — appreciate the heads up and good idea.

We can do a conversion to milestone credits instead of a blanket time extension. Proposed conversion: 12 unused trial days = 2 "priority tuning" credits. Each credit entitles Quoll to: up to 3 hours of prioritized inference tuning OR one reserved 2-hour concierge session with an engineer, to be used against the POC environment. Credits valid for 60 days from the amendment effective date.

Operational notes:
- Credits consume from your existing pilot token allocation (no additional invoice).
- We’ll put a short one-page amendment in DocuSign and waive the standard amendment fee for this one-off.
- Need legal to sign off on the language; copying Ben for pricing/legal alignment and Monica for onboarding/logistics.

I attached a suggested milestone schedule showing where credits could be redeemed (and a lightweight amendment template). If that looks good I’ll send DocuSign and flag Legal to expedite.

Next steps:
1) Quoll confirms acceptance of proposed conversion and credit expiry window.
2) Redwood sends amendment via DocuSign.
3) Monica schedules kickoff for credit redemption.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

Attachments: Quoll_POC_Milestone_Schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Oliver Wong <oliver@quoll.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jul 2025 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quoll POC timeline — small ask

Thanks Steph — quick internal note and suggestion for the amendment language.

Pricing/legal: I’m comfortable with 12 days -> 2 credits as described, with 60-day expiry, provided we include:
- Clear definition of what a credit covers (priority queue vs. on-site/on-call).
- A one-time non-refundable admin waiver (we’ll set to $0 but keep the clause).
- Confirmation that credits draw only from the pilot allocation and won’t convert to monetary credit post-pilot.

Suggested clause snippet (for Legal): "Credits are non-transferable, will be consumed from the existing pilot allocation, and expire 60 days after the amendment execution date; credits do not entitle the customer to refunds or future monetary credits."

If Quoll is OK with that, I’ll review the DocuSign before it goes out.

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Oliver Wong <oliver@quoll.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@quoll.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Jul 2025 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quoll POC timeline — small ask

Thanks, Stephanie and Ben. That structure sounds reasonable. A couple quick clarifying Qs from our side before we sign:
1) If we don’t use a credit within 60 days due to scheduling, can we request a one-time 30-day grace window?
2) Does consuming a credit during a production-like stress test count toward any usage or billing thresholds that would trigger overage charges? We want to avoid unexpected metering spikes.

If you can confirm both, we’ll accept and sign the amendment. Happy to do a 15-min call if that’s easier.

—Oliver

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Wong <oliver@quoll.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jul 2025 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quoll POC timeline — small ask

Hi Oliver — Monica from CS here. Quick answers and next steps from onboarding side:

1) One-time 30-day grace window: we can include this as a contingency but it requires an approved request form. We’ll add the clause: "Subject to approval, customer may request a one-time 30-day extension on credit expiry. Approval will be granted at Redwood’s discretion and must be requested before credit expiry."

2) Credit consumption and metering: using a credit for prioritized tuning sessions will be executed on the pilot cluster under Redwood’s pilot allocation and should not independently trigger overage billing. If you run a production-level stress test that exceeds the pilot cluster’s allocated tokens, that activity would be metered as usual. To avoid surprises, Monica can schedule a controlled tuning window and pre-warm the pilot quota.

I attached the onboarding checklist and proposed dates for redeeming the two credits. If you confirm the times we’ll reserve engineering slots.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Attachments: Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Wong <oliver@quoll.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quoll POC timeline — small ask

Great — thank you all for the quick alignment. Per thread:
- We’ll convert the 12 unused trial days into 2 priority-tuning credits.
- Credits valid 60 days, with a one-time 30-day grace window per Monica’s contingency language.
- Credits consume pilot allocation and should not independently trigger overage if used for tuning; any production-level stress tests remain metered.

I’ve sent the DocuSign with the amendment (link below). Please sign when convenient; once fully executed Monica will lock in the engineering windows for July 21 and July 28 as requested.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/sign/placeholder-link-8421
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8421

Stephanie
